items.summary: Critical KK flows must not claim Agent use from prompts, names, or manual imitation. Agent use requires registered routing, actual invocation, persistent evidence, and the flow-specific acceptance gate.

Ultra Deep Scan is a discovery-to-production governed workflow, not a storefront lookup or a search-only report. Scanner remains staging-only; Verifier and governed promotion/readback remain mandatory.

Every KK social-post request must use the governed Marketing, Content Strategy, Content Agent, Content QA and Content Selector route; multi-post requests additionally require batch diversity QA and persistent invocation evidence.

KK learning is evidence-based adaptation with durable failure, decision and performance feedback. It must not be described as autonomous model retraining, and learned changes remain governed by regression and review gates.

New KK work sessions must bootstrap from durable project memory containing locked rules, decisions, implementations, incidents, blockers, next actions and acceptance evidence. Customer data and secrets are excluded; current business truth must still come from canonical systems.

X posting-plan requests for KK Phone Rental are a default governed flow: route through x_posting_plan without requiring an explicit enable-agent command, use Asia/Bangkok slots 19:30 / 21:00 / 22:30 / 00:00 (late night), rank verified candidates using engagement velocity, conversation volume, event proximity, fandom strength, competitor activity, booking opportunity and recent-post fatigue, and remain read-only with owner review.

The default x_posting_plan Marketing Agent flow has one canonical GitHub-native owner-only runtime on main: .github/workflows/kk-x-posting-plan-chat-bridge.yml → scripts/kk-x-posting-plan-chat-bridge.js → Agent Gateway. It persists invocation evidence, returns Asia/Bangkok posting slots/rankings, and remains read-only with zero publishes and zero production writes. This runtime continues to work even while Vercel refuses new deployments because of the free daily deployment quota.

Post-cleanup LIVE acceptance passed for the default KK x_posting_plan flow. Current main has exactly one X posting-plan workflow. Issue #483 triggered only the canonical KK X Posting Plan Agent; Gateway status was RECORDED, required/invoked agent was kk-marketing-agent, timezone was Asia/Bangkok, verified candidates were ranked into 19:30 / 21:00 / 22:30 / 00:00 slots, unverified candidates were rejected, and publishes/production writes remained zero. New KK sessions must treat this Agent flow as already active and must not require the owner to re-enable it.

Before any KK X event-posting schedule or X-signal ranking: FIRST read canonical booking/inventory truth. If a date has an active booking, exclude events on that date from promotional scheduling per owner rule; do not let X signal override this gate. Then verify event date/status, inspect KK X recent-post history, collect current public X signal evidence, reject stale/past events, apply recent-post fatigue, and invoke governed x_posting_plan Marketing Agent. Never invent native X views/impressions; proxy scores must be labeled evidence-derived. Use 60–90 minute standalone spacing (75-minute baseline). Persist PLANNED separately from POSTED and learn from actual publish time + reach/engagement.

KK Unified Inbox is being upgraded from read-only to governed LINE operation: verified inbound events hydrate LINE display names, blank historical LINE names are backfilled from Admin, and outbound LINE text requires authenticated owner confirmation, provider retry-key protection, durable outbound persistence and audit. X outbound and AI auto-send remain disabled. Continue from the recovery document and exact runtime acceptance evidence rather than rebuilding the old read-only foundation.

KK Unified Inbox adds a shop-controlled owner_label separate from provider display_name, mirroring LINE OA friend-name editing. Admin shows owner_label first, preserves the original provider profile name for verification, supports an explicit rename dialog and a reset-to-provider-name action, searches owner labels, and audits changes. Suggested operational format is customer name + booking date + rented model. The canonical Inbox Supabase migration add_inbox_owner_customer_labels has been applied. Continue from docs/UNIFIED_INBOX_OWNER_LABEL_2026-10-04.md and exact deployment evidence; do not overwrite provider display_name to implement shop labels.

Unified Inbox stale-message bug root cause is browser refresh lifecycle, not auth or HTTP cache: inbound webhook rows persist, but Admin had no polling/subscription and only re-fetched on explicit UI actions, so logout/login happened to reveal new messages. Fix polls conversations every 4s only while Inbox is active/visible, refreshes selected thread only when its conversation version changes, catches up immediately on focus/visibility/online/tab-open/manual Refresh, prevents overlapping polls, and preserves scroll position. Media/Flex parity remains a separate defect.

Admin backend small-cleanup audit found no duplicate static HTML ids, no nav/tab mismatch, and all eight Admin forms are wired. Low-risk Inbox cleanup adds durable audited mark-read semantics, clears unread badges when actually read, preserves unread while owner is scrolled up, formats message timestamps in Asia/Bangkok, gives non-text messages readable fallback labels, and removes internal/English copy roughness. Actual media retrieval/rendering, Booking Flex mirroring, LINE OA Manager outbound reconciliation, Apps Script source gate, Direct Writer identity, Issue #489 data integrity, and Vercel production activation remain separate larger work.

When the owner asks to scan/add events to the KK storefront, Discovery must be recall-first and fandom/rental-opportunity centric, then new-event publication must pass an external-market-only demand gate. Score weights: competitor rental activity 30, public social engagement 20, ticket demand/sold-out/added-round 15, fandom photo intent 15, venue capture value 10, historical external rental activity 10. PRIORITY >=75; publish >=60; WATCH 45-59.9; reject <45; insufficient evidence VERIFY_MORE. KK booking, revenue, conversion, inquiry, full-stock and waitlist data must never affect External Demand Score; they may only raise discovery priority for the same/adjacent fandom. VERIFY_MORE/WATCH/REJECT must never reach CREATE_EVENT. Owner visibility locks remain authoritative and no automatic reopen is allowed.

October 2026 external-demand reconciliation rerun completed for 7-31 Oct under the new fandom-first policy. Initial visible storefront count 42; final production-visible count 50 (47 show, 3 show_full). Net +8: added FAYE PERAYA BIRTHDAY PARTY 2026 1410 STATIC; restored 4 durable owner REOPENED rows (TEEHENG 24 Oct, OMEGA X 24 Oct, GUN NAPAT Birthday 24 Oct, T.O.P PRE-STUDIO 24 Oct); external-demand-reactivated 3 non-LOCKED hidden rows with capacity (LINGORM 18 Oct score ~97, GMMTV FANIVAL 7 Oct ~84, Avenged Sevenfold 7 Oct ~79). No additional removals in this rerun; prior low-demand prune remains LOCKED and Love On Hire Blessing Ceremony remains retained. Production /api/kk-data readback found all 8 changed event IDs as show and 3 package rows each. Monthly flow now re-scores existing visible cards, can remove <45 when owner apply is active, keeps 45-59.9 existing cards as WATCH_KEEP, reactivates hidden non-LOCKED >=60 only with capacity, restores durable REOPENED intent, never overrides LOCKED, and emits an ADDED/REMOVED/REACTIVATED/RESTORED diff.

OWNER LOCK 2026-10-15: Thai request 'ขอโพสปล่อยเช่างานนี้บน X' (or equivalent single/multiple events) means FINISHED X PREMIUM RENTAL COPY, exactly ONE best copy-ready Final per event; never ask owner to pick among variants. Verify live Core/Storefront price, booking/owner locks, all event dates and venue, poster, verified artist/fandom hashtags and X post history. Run real Marketing→Strategy→Content (3 differentiated INTERNAL drafts)→QA→Selector + Batch Diversity; log persistent Agent invocation/PASS. If bridge fails disclose blocker; never call a manual draft Agent-selected. Use measured real engagement/conversions for Learning AI; claim Hugging Face only with successful call evidence and no extra cost. Brand header once; model only in price; five distinct VERIFIED hashtags; rich event-specific X Premium hook, distinct booking CTA and canonical link; correct four verified benefits, no scarcity invention, no device counts. Public dates use ✅ ว่าง for verified available days or ❌ เต็ม for confirmed full days; owner-closed/hidden/locked dates are omitted from public copy and kept unchanged in backend. Owner approval before X publication. No production/booking/permission writes, no spend or phantom PASS.

X owner copy (2026-10-15): For each event provide ONE selected X Premium long-form rental post, not 3 external alternatives. Read current approved price and booking/all event dates first; preserve hidden/owner-closed backend states while excluding locked days from public copy; show ✅ ว่าง for verified available dates and ❌ เต็ม only for genuinely full dates. Header exactly '📱 KK Phone Rental | #เช่ามือถือ' once, no brand repeat, device model only on price line, no stock count or invented urgency. Use at least FIVE distinct verified hashtags: rental header + official event tag + 3 relevant artist/fandom closing tags; fail closed when tags unverified. CTA must invite booking naturally and differ across event/fandom/recent posts; the old fixed CTA is NOT a universal requirement. Rich event-specific hook, explain actual lens-use benefit without guaranteeing image quality; verified insurance, deposit conditional on X follow, venue pickup/tutorial, Drive 30 days, discounts only when verified. Three internal candidates→QA→Selector→batch diversity; Agent Ledger must persist. No false measured Learning AI/Hugging Face claims, no auto-X posting or paid compute. Detailed rules in referenced docs/skill.
